ends.note: ends at the west wall of the Dixie Terminal Building (north); the 10' alley leaves its south side here and runs south to E. 3rd

notes: Single block Vine-Walnut, E. 4th-E. 3rd. Ogden Place (printed OGDEN PL. (BAKER), 20') runs east from Vine and stops short of Walnut at the Dixie Terminal Building; recorded as Ogden Place (the old name Baker is printed in brackets). An unnamed 10' alley runs from the east end of Ogden Place south to E. 3rd between the Dixie Terminal Building (south) and the buildings on the Walnut frontage. Vine drifts about 10 px east from 4th to 3rd. Sheet is a later paste-over state (Dixie Terminal 1919-21, Sinton Hotel annex 1920).
